quality.note: Logs captured before sixth acceptance compile: 14 held-out and seven spinning five-minute courses.

resources.note: Comparable Python zlib gzip1,mtime0. After is an intermediate build; final resource figures belong in report. Node gzip totals intentionally not mixed with baseline.

support.note: Unchanged dependencies; checkout supplies assembly and non-Go assets.

omitted: Executables and scratch overlays are intentionally not archived. prepare.ts regenerates portable overlays.

reproductionValidation.note: Portable archived baseline with original and five-case fixtures, archived sixth with five-case fixture, and final archived seventh with five-case fixture compiled successfully. No timing rerun during curation.

final.note: The report owns interpretation; original raw captures and executable/source identities are retained unchanged.
